accessibility.contrast_check: Ensure all text meets WCAG AA (4.5:1) against the dark background. Avoid dark gray on black.
accessibility.interactive_elements: All buttons and links must have a focus state visible (e.g., ring-2 ring-blue-500).
accessibility.reduced_motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion media query for all animations.

instructions_to_main_agent: STRICTLY follow the dark theme guidelines. No light mode toggles.
Use 'Inter' font for all UI text. Use 'JetBrains Mono' or 'Monospace' for technical specs (lens data, prices, sensor sizes).
Implement the 'Cinematic' vibe by using high contrast, sharp edges, and subtle blue glows.
For the 'Script Analysis' feature, visualize the data. Don't just list text. Use progress bars, tags, or icons.
Ensure the 'Rental House' dashboard is dense and data-rich (like a spreadsheet or camera menu).
Ensure the 'Filmmaker' dashboard is visual and project-focused (like a portfolio).
Add 'data-testid' to all interactive elements for testing.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Avoid 'AI slop' aesthetic (generic centered layouts, gradients).
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for overlays.
Every interaction needs micro-animations (hover, focus, active).
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures and noise overlays separate good from extraordinary.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠 in the UI.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui.
